Document: # Rule 1.5 Do not communicate in-round information about an ongoing round to other people. - Communicating current-round info out of character — also known as "metacommunicating" or "metacomming" — includes posting media relating to a live round, discussing in-character events in out-of-character chats, discussing an ongoing round in a voice call, etc. - Do not multikey, which is to play or spectate in the same round with multiple accounts operated by you. - Participating in a voice call with other players is permitted as long as it is done within the official AFTERLIGHT discord server. [bold]You are still disallowed from sharing in-round information[/bold].
